assumptions.statement: The Gridelyx identity migration may use an explicit breaking protocol/native ABI v2 boundary rather than retaining pre-v2 project-owned public/source identifiers in the current tree.
assumptions.validation_route: Validate strict whole-tree terminology, GLXB/GLXM v2 identity, Java/native/Bedrock builds and rollback/recovery documentation.
assumptions.review_trigger: A compatibility adapter for a pre-v2 consumer is proposed
assumptions.impact_if_false: An isolated versioned compatibility adapter may be required without changing the canonical Gridelyx v2 identity.

assumptions.statement: A web/GitHub collision screen can identify obvious existing uses but cannot prove trademark, company-name, domain or worldwide legal availability.
assumptions.validation_route: Perform jurisdiction-appropriate trademark/business/domain clearance before commercial release.
assumptions.review_trigger: Public or commercial Gridelyx release preparation
assumptions.impact_if_false: A name considered clear from ordinary search could still conflict legally or commercially.
